articles.title: Plannen om pesticideregels in EU te versoepelen, verontrusten artsen en milieuverenigingen
articles.snippet: Aan het Europees Parlement in Straatsburg is geprotesteerd tegen de versoepeling van de Europese pesticideregels. Nu moet de vergunning van gewasbeschermingsmiddelen nog elke 10 tot 15 jaar herzien worden. De Europese Commissie wil die periode verlengen en in sommige gevallen zelfs schrappen. Landbouwers en agrobedrijven zijn voorstander van de versoepelingen, milieuverenigingen en artsen vrezen "eeuwige" vergunningen.

articles.title: Flagship UK gigafactory plan in turmoil after it loses second builder in five months
articles.snippet: Tata-owned Agratas plant to build EV batteries for sister company Jaguar Land Rover seen as crucial for long-term health of British car industry One of the UK’s flagship electric vehicle battery projects has been thrown into turmoil after its second building contractor in five months walked away, adding to questions over when Jaguar Land Rover cars will use British-made batteries. The £5.2bn gigafactory in Bridgwater, Somerset, is being built by Agratas, to provide batteries for Britain’s largest automotive employer, its sister company.
